3D TERRAIN VIEW
3D is for visual context. Return to 2D for precise editing, measurement and report capture.
WaterSewerPowerCommunicationsStormwaterGasUnknown
On a computer, move the map by clicking and dragging; the pointer remains a normal arrow until an editing tool is active. Choose a utility from the always-visible toolbar inside the map. Its correct colour is selected automatically and line drawing starts immediately. On a touchscreen, tap points to draw the utility line, then use the large Finish control inside the map. Use Cancel to abandon the current drawing and return to normal map movement. On a computer, right-drag draws a Smart Utility Line for the selected service; right-click without dragging still finishes click-point lines and measurements. Middle-drag orbits the 3D view when 3D View is active: move left/right to rotate and up/down to tilt. Right-click browser menus are disabled inside the map. Esc cancels the active tool. Double-tap also finishes multi-point work on touchscreens. For touch or stylus work, use Map Lock so the map cannot pan while drawing. Unlock it again to pan or pinch-zoom. Use 3D View to switch into terrain mode. While 3D is active, hold the middle mouse button and drag in any direction to orbit: left/right rotates and up/down changes the viewing angle. Use Freehand Sketch to draw directly over the map using the selected utility colour and line width. Use the floating Finish or Cancel controls when finished. Draw Utility also opens the pen, marker, highlighter, line and shape tools. While drawing a utility line, click or tap a hydrant, valve or other symbol to attach the line exactly to its centre. Nearby line points also snap automatically to symbols. With Auto Finish When Connected enabled, the line finishes automatically as soon as its second or later point connects to a symbol, preventing accidental extra segments. Hover over a line, freehand sketch, shape or symbol and click or tap it to open its controls, including colour, move, resize, rotate, duplicate, Add Label and individual delete options. Labels automatically attach to the selected item. Existing labels can be clicked for edit, resize and remove controls.
